modelVisibleChanges: exec: the path command-shape sentence now states one command name and no whitespace splitting; `not-found` names the exact literal that was looked for, per backend wording (plain/frozen vs sandbox/captured).

exec: a known result is now `{command, cwd, outcome, exitCode, signal, stdout, stderr, stdoutTruncated, stderrTruncated}`; a process killed by a signal without a termination request closes as known/failed `outcome:"signaled"` with the signal name instead of an unknown/uncertain observation.

process-read: waitMs above 30,000 is clamped to the ceiling and executed; the succeeded receipt carries `waitMsClampedFrom`. Other bounds (maxBytes, stdin, argv, lifetimeMs) are still rejected, never clamped.

process-read/write/stop: a refused ref now closes as `process-expired` (with `expiredAtMs` and `retainedMs`) or `process-unknown-ref`; `process-unavailable` is no longer admitted, and a process with a live record stays readable.

subagent: the display name is 1 to 5 code points; a longer name (up to 64) is accepted and shortened to its first 5, and the result states `acceptedName` plus `truncatedFrom`; continue/cancel select by the same first-5 rule. An empty name or more than 64 code points is still invalid.

workspace files: write creates missing parent directories inside the workspace, and read admits an in-workspace symlink (an escaping symlink is still refused); both behaviours are now stated in the tool descriptions rather than learned from an error.

attempt delivery: the tool-free delivery Plan freezes the primary Plan's maxModelOutputBytes (4,194,304) instead of a second 4,096-byte bound; the 180,000 ms reserve, the single delivery cycle and the adoption rule are unchanged.
candidateDeltaAudit.unchangedPipelinePaths: No change to the harness-facing argv, the `--attempt-remaining-ms` / `--model-timeout-ms` parsing and its >210000 ms floor, the per-call ceiling (generation.modelInvocationTimeoutMs = 1800000), the tool-call caps, the retry policy or the kernel plan/transition.

knownRisks.ecrThrottle: Serialization removes the concurrent-pull trigger, but a throttle caused by other tenants on the shared public.ecr.aws quota cannot be excluded; if it recurs, the cell again has no model attempt and nothing is retried inside this run.
knownRisks.fixVisibility: These 7 fixes are contract-level: a cell can only exhibit them if the model again makes the same call shape. A clean cell therefore does not by itself prove the fix, which is why the deterministic local contract probes below are recorded alongside this batch, and a recurring closure is the stronger evidence.
knownRisks.attemptDelivery: Spec 271 corrects the delivery output bound only. The primary Run is still stopped at budget minus the 180 s reserve, so the two terminal-bench cells are expected to remain unfinished; what must change is that the attempt ends with an adopted delivery report (exit 0, graded cell) instead of model-output-too-large with no verdict.
knownRisks.credentialExpiry: BENCHMARK_PROVIDER_API_KEY is the rotating dim OAuth JWT; the earlier batch recorded an expiry five days out from 2026-09-30. Every Generate job verifies the credential at materialization before any attempt.
knownRisks.budget: Five 5400 s cells plus two 900 s cells run serially, so this batch is expected to take up to about four hours in the worst case.
